Derry Diocesan Pilgrimage to Lourdes 2027 , led by Bishop Michael Router. There are two options available as follows: Option 1 : 8 - 13 July, 5 nights, £980, from City of Derry Airport, with priority given to Assisted Pilgrims and family members, Care Team, Youth, Youth Leaders and Priests. Option 2 : 7 - 14 July, 7 nights, £1,095, from Belfast International Airport. Single Supplement and Travel Insurance will be extra. Expressions of Interest can be emailed to

. Bookings will begin in mid- January, with more details later. Pilgrimage Gift Vouchers of any value are available from the Pastoral Centre, Bishop Street, Derry, for anyone wishing to purchase them, particularly as a Christmas Gift. Please contact

for further information. The Columban Young Adults is a group for those aged 18 - 35 in the diocese, who are seeking a community of like-minded young adults who have Christ at the centre of their lives. Our December event will be a Holy Hour and meditation on Thursday 3rd December, 7.00pm at our Lady of Lourdes Church, Steelstown, delivered by guest Fr Brendan O’Connor, a priest of Opus Dei. Please note the earlier date, due to Christmas. The meditation will be followed by Solemn Benediction, with refreshments afterwards. Accord Derry Marriage Preparation Courses January 2027 to March 2027 are now online for booking . The courses can be booked on the website

. All of these courses are in person. Free 4-Week Dementia Education Programme for Family Carers Starting Thursday 21st January 2027, 7.00pm at the Health for Life Healthy Living Centre, Creggan. Designed for those supporting a loved one with a dementia diagnosis at home. Learn about dementia, communication, behaviours, coping strategies, and available supports. Family members are welcome to attend together. Please note: this course is not suitable for people living with dementia or those currently undergoing assessment/diagnosis. Booking essential:
